capabilities: Highlight Protocol Buffers keywords, types, strings, numbers, and comments in code blocks
Highlight inline nanopb extensions such as (nanopb).max_length
Highlight separate nanopb .options blocks with field patterns and comments
Add a copy button to code blocks in Reading view
Support Reading view, Live Preview, and Source mode
disambiguation: Not a validator, compiler, or editor for .proto files; it only adds syntax highlighting inside fenced code blocks.
extras: Not yet listed in the official Community directory; installed manually from GitHub releases or built from source. Local processing only, no network requests.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in syntax highlighting for proto, protobuf, or nanopb code blocks.
summary: Syntax highlighter for Protocol Buffers and nanopb code in fenced Markdown code blocks, with a copy button in Reading view.
